name: northwind
description: Northwind Ops — flagship demo for the neode OGM: API + UI + tests over the classic Northwind graph

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts src/seed/cli.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=dist --platform=node --target=es2022 --sourcemap --external:neode && cp -R src/seed/data dist/seed/data && cp -R src/seed/data dist/data && vite build
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server.ts src/seed/cli.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=dist --platform=node --target=es2022 --sourcemap --external:neode && cp -R src/seed/data dist/seed/data && cp -R src/seed/data dist/data
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,ui 'pnpm build:server >/dev/null && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js --platform=node --target=es2022 --sourcemap --external:neode --watch' 'node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch dist/server.js' 'vite'
